**PotentialPunch 1.5.0**

- **USER presets.** A new USER page with 8 slots: tap **SAVE**, then a slot, to keep the sound you have now; tap a slot to bring it back. Filled slots read USER 1 to USER 8, empty ones EMPTY, and the slot you loaded last is lit. No typing.
- The slots are kept in a file beside your VST2 Plugins folder (`PotentialSuite Presets/PotentialPunch.txt`), so every project and every copy of the plugin sees the same slots, and updating the plugin keeps them.
- Use the same slot number in PotentialPatina, PotentialHeat, PotentialGrit and PotentialBleed to keep a chain of your own.
- **MANUAL page.** The plugin's manual is now on the MPC's screen: tap **MANUAL**, then the page buttons along the top (what it does, the controls, presets, the FX chains and their insert order, USER presets). The full PotentialSuite manual is on the [PotentialSuite page](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins).
- Ten parameters were added at the end of the list (Save User Preset, User 1 to User 8, Manual Page); saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialPunch-1.5.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialPunch-1.5.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialPunch-1.5.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialPunch-1.5.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch/issues/new/choose).
